description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the array_utils.php utility functions within the SuiteCRM project. It defines a test class 'array_utilsTest' with multiple test methods that verify the behavior of various utility functions such as var_export_helper, override_value_to_string, add_blank_option, override_value_to_string_recursive, object_to_array_recursive, deepArrayDiff, setDeepArrayValue, array_merge_values, array_search_insensitive, and fixIndexArrayFormat.

classes.name: array_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class validating various utility functions for array manipulation within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.description: Tests that var_export_helper correctly serializes an array into a string representation.
